# Nutritional Specialist Skill for Muse

Turn Muse into a personalized nutrition advisor: on first use it collects your goals, allergies, restrictions (veggie, keto, halal…), tastes, and health conditions through a conversational questionnaire, then stores everything in a persistent local JSON database via `scripts/preferences_manager.py`. Every later food request — recipes, meal planning, groceries, substitutions — is filtered through those preferences: allergies are strictly respected, options stay aligned with your goals. Preferences can be updated or reset at any time. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: a setup questionnaire on first use, local storage only — and this is not medical advice. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
